description: Given a company domain, returns a validated company profile: business name, firmographics (for example service area and team size) and a technology-stack summary, written by a model on Agent Harbor's own hardware and checked claim by claim against the scraped page evidence; unsupported claims are struck and provenance is included. No input reaches a third-party AI provider. Not charged on failure. Costs $0.05 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, no scheme or path, e.g. mailchimp.com
